cand.title: Expo Nacional Ferretera 2027
cand.excerpt: High event credibility and geographic fit; current-edition accessibility is constrained by a confirmed non-hotel venue, so the opportunity is ranked for overflow/ancillary or future capture rather than assumed open inventory.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Grecia Magdaleno Damken is the named official-agency contact and the strongest accommodation intermediary lead. Francisco López Muñoz is identified by RX in February 2026 as Show Manager; the event contact page lists Francisco López as Product Manager. Javier García is identified by RX as Portfolio Director and by the event page as Show Director. These are relevant routing and relationship contacts, not verified hotel-contract signatories.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming Guadalajara edition: 9–11 September 2027 at Expo Guadalajara, within the requested horizon. The official homepage title, header and footer agree and the body says “Nos vemos en 2027.” Its remaining 3–5 September 2026 call-to-action is historical carry-over, not the upcoming dates. These are activity dates, not publication dates. No 2028 Guadalajara dates verified.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: Sheraton Guadalajara Expo is well matched to exhibitor teams, visiting buyers and ancillary meetings rather than resort-style residential programming. Marriott places it near Expo Guadalajara and Plaza del Sol and publishes guestrooms, dining, business amenities and meeting facilities. This supports an Expo-corridor accommodation proposition; it does not establish event room demand at this hotel. Use the supplied 216-room inventory as hotel context only, not a proposed block. Avoid claiming the hotel can replace the exhibition venue or promising an unverified walking time.
findings.venueCommitments: The organizer publicly names Expo Guadalajara for 9–11 September 2027. This is a non-hotel exhibition venue, not an incumbent accommodation hotel. Public venue announcement is verified; the executed venue contract and hotel-block commitments are not public in the reviewed evidence.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified Guadalajara sequence: 5–7 September 2024, 4–6 September 2025, and 3–5 September 2026, all at Expo Guadalajara; the announced 2027 edition retains that venue. This establishes consecutive editions, not destination rotation. RX describes Mexico City as an additional edition launched in 2025, not a relocation of Guadalajara. Historical hotel-programme incumbents were not verified for recent editions.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing status: unknown, neither verified open nor verified closed for 2027. The event’s 2026 accommodation announcement identifies Corporativo ODE as exclusive travel agency and Grecia Magdaleno Damken as reservations contact. The current homepage still names Grecia under “Agencia oficial”; this alone does not prove a renewed 2027 exclusive appointment. ODE’s event page offers nearby-hotel rates and booking codes on request, but no verified 2027 supplier-onboarding window, RFP, room allotment or contracting terms were found.
findings.organizationStructure: RX organizes Expo Nacional Ferretera; this is a corporate-organized B2B hardware trade exhibition, not an association-owned conference established by the evidence. Expo Guadalajara is the venue. Corporativo ODE is the identified 2026 accommodation/travel intermediary, distinct from owner and venue. Do not describe ODE as event owner or assume a 2027 PCO mandate.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The main exhibition venue is already publicly identified, limiting exhibition-space capture but not proving hotel accommodation is closed. The 2026 exclusive ODE booking channel creates an established intermediary pathway; its 2027 mandate and incumbent hotels remain unverified. No sourced 2027 sellout, displaced group, unmet room demand or overflow request was found. Historical attendance must not be converted into room nights or Sheraton capture.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: First contact Grecia to confirm whether ODE handles 2027 housing, obtain the current hotel roster and ask whether Sheraton can submit rates and conditions. In parallel, ask Francisco López to identify the RX accommodation/programme decision-maker and whether exhibitor teams or Club Elite need rooms or off-floor meetings. Offer an Expo-corridor hotel introduction and request required dates, peak rooms, rate ceiling, commission, release and cancellation terms before issuing a proposal. If closed, record incumbent contract periods and the next review date; do not label the lead an open RFP or proven overflow.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the selected upcoming 2027 edition: exhibition-venue capture is not an open prospect on present evidence; accommodation and ancillary-meeting access remain unconfirmed and require direct outreach. There is a named historical hotel intermediary, but no verified 2027 RFP or available block. The September 2026 edition is expired and is used only as relationship and sourcing evidence.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: seek inclusion in the 2027 hotel programme if supplier selection remains accessible, while developing direct exhibitor/team business and ancillary-meeting referrals. If contracted allocations are already fixed, request the next hotel-selection review and documented overflow criteria. Continued Guadalajara editions support relationship development, but do not prove an open future hotel competition; no 2028 dates or hotel selection timetable are confirmed.

cibMappingHints.whoToContact: Grecia Magdaleno Damken at Corporativo ODE first; Francisco López at RX for routing; Javier García for senior relationship escalation.
cibMappingHints.whyThisHotel: Inference: near-Expo city business hotel with guestrooms, dining and meeting facilities; stronger fit for show-related stays than resort programming.
cibMappingHints.whatIsHappening: RX’s Guadalajara hardware trade exhibition is announced for 9–11 September 2027 at Expo Guadalajara.
cibMappingHints.potentialBusiness: Unquantified exhibitor/buyer guestrooms and ancillary meetings; no confirmed block, room nights or overflow.
cibMappingHints.recommendedNextStep: Confirm 2027 housing mandate and hotel supplier-selection access before preparing a commercial proposal.
cibMappingHints.accessibilityStatement: Main exhibition venue announced; 2027 hotel sourcing unconfirmed, not verified open or closed.
